aboutGame.title: What is Transport Fever 3?
paragraphs: Transport Fever 3 is the next-generation transport management and tycoon simulation developed by Urban Games and published by Paradox Interactive. Players step into the role of a transport magnate, designing intricate transit networks across land, sea, and air through distinct historical eras starting from 1850 into the modern age.

From laying complex railway corridors and configuring modular hubs to balancing dynamic multi-industry supply chains and urban traffic, Transport Fever 3 delivers unparalleled simulation depth, authentic vehicle rosters, and powerful modding support.

items.question: What is Transport Fever 3?
items.answer: Transport Fever 3 is a comprehensive transport management simulation game developed by Urban Games and published by Paradox Interactive. Players construct rail, road, maritime, and air logistics infrastructure to grow economies and connect thriving cities across multiple eras.

items.question: When will Transport Fever 3 be released?
items.answer: Transport Fever 3 is scheduled to launch in 2026 for PC, Mac, Linux, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

items.question: How many vehicles are available in Transport Fever 3?
items.answer: Transport Fever 3 features over 300 faithfully modeled historical and modern vehicles, including trains, buses, trucks, cargo ships, and aircraft.

items.question: Does Transport Fever 3 support mods and the Steam Workshop?
items.answer: Yes, Transport Fever 3 features robust modding support with an integrated mod browser and Steam Workshop integration for community-created vehicles, maps, and custom assets.

items.question: What editions are available for Transport Fever 3?
items.answer: Transport Fever 3 is available in Standard Edition, Deluxe Edition featuring exclusive bonus vehicles and cosmetic skins, and a physical Collector's Edition.
